title: SMS reminder (tap-to-send)
description: Same as WhatsApp reminder but via an SMS intent (smsto:), pre-filled, tap-to-send only.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping opens the default SMS app pre-filled with tenant number and message

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

SMS half of the same build as LODGY-18: ReminderIntents.sms() uses ACTION_VIEW on an smsto: Uri with the message passed via the sms_body extra - no SEND_SMS permission requested or declared anywhere in the manifest (confirmed by grep). `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL.
